description: 40 separate unapproved review tasks. Cambridge URLs are lookup leads, not observations.

english_definition_review.task: Independently check exact English sense and POS with source and reviewer.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese editor checks meaning, naturalness and register.

example_review.task: Independently check grammar, collocation and intended sense.

cefr_review.task: Check sense-specific CEFR evidence; reclassify or quarantine unsupported tier.

audio_review.task: After text approval, generate and listen to both George/Emma word and example audio, including physical iPhone Safari.
